browser: The user's stable Google Chrome, driven through the official Claude in Chrome extension in its own tab-group window. Keys were synthetic in-page keydown/keyup events; touch buttons, Start, the language switch, menu cells on the canvas and Play again were real mouse clicks. Only visible DOM text and the drawn canvas were read; no game state was read or injected.
phoneLayouts: Checked in a same-origin 390-wide portrait frame on the page (371 px inner width, no horizontal overflow).
servedSourceCheck: The SHA-256 of all four served phase-tiles modules was computed in the page and matched 2c81d920, 5f77d459, 60bd8bc6 and aba765af.

observed: A driver that reads only the English status line, with a 0.35 s reaction delay and pressing an arrow exactly as many times as the line says, played boards 1 to 26 back to back in 6 minutes 26 seconds and reached 'Nicely played! Every board is clear. The loom is yours!' with the maximum score of 2600. It never needed an undo or a repeated action.
Chinese board select listed all 26 boards; two taps on the canvas entered board 8.

Chinese: spending board 8's seven presses on one tile showed 'Z：撤销多余的一步' from the first wasted press and the canvas countdown '次数用完：按 Z 撤销（4 秒）'. Without an undo the run ended exactly 8.0 s after the last press with '第 8 块棋盘的按压次数用完了，再试一次。'. Z, arrows, Space and Q on the loss screen changed nothing, and Play again returned to board select.
Chinese phone frame: real taps on the touch buttons alone, following the prompt, cleared boards 1 and 2. A wrong press was taken back with the Undo button, and Reset restored board 3 after a press.
The game paused itself twice when the window lost focus; the driver pressed the visible Resume button.

limitations: Physical phones, other browsers, the English phone header and audio were not tested; console output was not captured.
